notes: Progression graph (P2-S6, DATA_SCHEMA_SPEC §2.8). Boss nodes are generated 1:1 from overlays/bosses.json (same slug, Boss↔Node symmetric); `nodes` here are the milestone and event MARKERS (AMENDMENTS-001 A3: no event pages, no event Boss records). Node `stage` is the editorial five-stage tag; a milestone carries the stage it opens (hardmode = early-hm, all-mechanical-bosses = mid-hm).

Edge semantics. required-gate A→B: in a world, B cannot be fought / cannot occur until A is defeated or reached (hard dependency; the required-gate subgraph is a DAG and drives gatedBy transitive reduction and E_SUGGESTION_GATING). optional A→B: B is available from A on and is not required for game progression (nothing required-gates out of B). recommended-next A→B: the wiki recommends B after A (soft order). alternative-route: world-exclusive alternatives (Eater of Worlds / Brain of Cthulhu). early-challenge-possible A→B: B can be challenged as soon as A is reached although its intended stage is later. A boss may have a required-gate AND an optional / early-challenge edge — they state different facts.

Single-world convention: edges model progression inside one world. Cross-world transfers the wiki mentions (Prismatic Lacewings, Truffle Worms, Celestial Sigils, Pirate Maps or Naughty Presents brought from another world) are not routes.

Every edge quote must occur verbatim on its `page` (checked against the cached revision) and is emitted as the edge note; `why` (pipeline-only) records how the quote supports the edge type where that is not literal.
goblin-army has no edge: its trigger (breaking a Shadow Orb / Crimson Heart, 200 max health) is not a progression node, and no boss gates it.

AMENDMENTS-015 B93(ii) (P6-S0): the three mechanical boss → all-mechanical-bosses edges quote a whole sentence of the Mechanical bosses article's "All bosses defeated" section; the earlier quote was the section's lead-in, cut where its list began.

Not expressible as edges (reported, not guessed): the Solar Eclipse also needs at least ONE mechanical boss defeated (an OR over three nodes; required-gate edges are AND), and Old One's Army tiers (not in the REQUIREMENTS §6 node list).

edges.quote: Plantera is a Hardmode boss that can be fought in the Underground Jungle after all three mechanical bosses (The Twins, The Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime) have been defeated.

Golem is summoned by using a Lihzahrd Power Cell at the Lihzahrd Altar located in the final chamber of the Jungle Temple, at any time, and only if the current world is in Hardmode after Plantera is defeated.
Prismatic Lacewings spawn in The Hallow on the Surface between dusk (7:30 PM) and midnight (12:00 AM) once Plantera has been defeated.
edges.why: She is summoned by killing a Prismatic Lacewing; lacewings carried over from another world are outside the single-world convention.

edges.quote: While she can be summoned as soon as Plantera is defeated, her difficulty is on par with that of a post-Golem boss, making her a serious threat to unprepared players.
The Empress of Light, an optional boss, can be fought after defeating Plantera, but it is recommended to fight her after beating the Golem.
